checks.title: sm-ui pinned exact (no ^, ~, github:, latest) in package.json [A,N,S]
pinned sm-ui equals the newest published tag or a declared exception [A warns only,N]
package-lock.json committed and in sync (npm ci passes) [A]
workflow installs with npm ci, never npm install [A,N]
secrets referenced by the workflow exist on the repo (PACKAGES, SM_API_KEY) [N]
kit files present: CODEOWNERS, .sm-workflow.conf at the fleet version, ci-gate job, AGENTS.md per the kit's adoption definition [A,N]
portal.json present with template name, template version and type; template version at or above the standard's minimum [A,N,S]
app imports Layout from @sprint-mode/sm-ui and defines no local component named Layout, Login, AccountSwitcher, PortalPicker, NotificationBellNav, PageGate or PortalSupportWidget [A,N]
/auth/login renders sm-ui Login with portal=<slug>; no local login form (no /auth/magic call outside sm-ui) [A,N]
no local role-list constant (SM_TEAM_ROLES, BUILT_IN_ROLES or literal role arrays); roles come from the session and portal-roles [A,N]
data-product=<slug> on <html> [A,N,S]
brand override block html[data-product=<slug>] with the seven variables when the slug is not in sm-ui's map [A,N]
no hardcoded hex colors or font-family in the portal's own CSS or JSX where a token exists (allowlist: the brand override block, SVG fills) [A warns,N]
portal_configs brand_color, brand_tint, logo_mark_url, logo_horizontal_url, logo_favicon_url, logo_og_url present and the R2 objects answer HEAD 200 [A warns,N,S]
favicon link and OG tags (title, description, og:image) present in the served HTML of each public route; legacy SPA shells flagged "SPA shell, no SEO" as a deviation with a standing exception [N]
prerendered HTML present for each public route declared in portal.json [N]
portal_roles has the nine team roles including super_admin with the fleet-standard display names; customer roles match the type's template or a declared list [N,S]
no active portal_members row whose person is inactive or departed (status fields, never a name list) [N]
the portal is present in the Team Roles matrix with super_admin granted [N,S]
CF Pages project exists, production branch is main (or the declared branch), git-connected to the portal's repo [N,S]
custom domains from portal_configs are attached to the Pages project, status active, DNS resolves [N]
production bundle: main JS asset over 100 KB with content-type application/javascript [N]
latest production deployment SHA equals main head [N]
portal_sections non-empty and matching the app's declared permKeys (sync ran) [N,S]
cached member counts equal live counts, until BUG-3172 removes the cache [N]
view-as feed declared explicitly (viewAsApi) or View-as absent; never the retired fallback [A,N]
the page gate reads the /auth/me shape the spine returns ({ ok, user }); a gate testing data.data alone is a deviation [A,N,S]
/api/portal/config resolves for the portal's own origins (each allowed domain plus the sprintmode.ai host): ok=true and config.name equals the portal name [N, deploy smoke]
no browser-side call to an auth host other than the spine (api.sprintmode.ai or the portal's own /api/sm proxy) [A warns,N]
